scope.unreviewed: Other peer paths, Zig remainder, unselected assign.go and prior restricted Rust resource are outside semantic review counts.

upstream_outcome_policy: Expected outcomes are inferred from pinned assertions and //run directives; no peer was executed. Go files expect silent successful main completion. Zig tests expect successful assertions when their explicit backend skip guards permit execution. Backend guards were read; no backend coverage claimed.
grouping_policy: One named Zig test with all in-scope helper functions or one Go main scenario with shared helpers. Helpers and assertion sites are not added to port or comparison counts.
local_coverage_policy: Existing local coverage denotes inspected source fixtures only, with exact ranges and full-file provenance hashes. No tests run or pass status inferred. Related coverage may not suffice for the selected upstream unit.
ownership_policy: Preserve simple automatic ownership and existing Minyar syntax; no new memory, pointer, sentinel, writable-view or tuple features proposed.

proposed_regressions.name: Exact loop progress and thresholds
proposed_regressions.original_regression: One bounded program checks increment-before-break=6, inclusive range sum=55, explicit while sum=55, condition overshoot=108 and odd-sum after continue=25. Use a range for continue or put explicit while update before the continue path.
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Existing related control fixtures have different thresholds; no exact Go ordinary-control adaptation exists here.

proposed_regressions.name: Fresh loop binding and explicit last-index tracking
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Keep outer i=0; for i in 0..5 assign an unrelated value to its fresh loop binding, count visits, then check outer i unchanged. Separately clear a five-element List by explicit range index and update last. Use effectful range-bound functions and check exactly one call to each.
proposed_regressions.expected: outer=0,visits=5; last=4 and five zeros; two bound calls total
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Existing lexical scope coverage lacks this exact outer-binding contrast. Effectful bounds are an original extension, not an assertion in Go for.go.

proposed_regressions.name: Explicit snapshots and one-record swap composition
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Perform 100 steps where new slots 1..9 receive old slots [2,3,4,1,9,5,6,7,8], explicitly capturing all nine scalar snapshots before writes. Check checksum every step and exact order every twentieth step. Return one explicit Pair record from a swap helper and apply it twice. Add a separate managed Text Pair capture-before-replacement control.
proposed_regressions.expected: sum 45 every step; ordered 1..9 at steps 20,40,60,80,100; two swaps preserve ordered input; old captured Text survives replacement
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Existing self assignment/literal capture does not cover this composition. This is an original staged algorithm regression, not missing multi-target/tuple syntax support. Managed Text is an original extension.

proposed_regressions.name: Shared Bytes owner versus copied slice
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Start Bytes spelling aaaa and keep an ordinary alias. A function writes z at source index 1, then copies slice 2..3 and writes y at copy index 0. Check source and alias separately. Write y directly to source index 2. Reassign both source and alias to fresh empty Bytes and verify the copied slice still reads y.
proposed_regressions.expected: source/alias=azaa,copy=y; direct source write yields azya through both aliases; copy survives source replacement
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Inspected slice fixtures only check values/length, not mutation independence. Use existing Bytes/local/function syntax; no writable view feature. Source-replacement lifetime is an original extension.

proposed_regressions.name: Bounded homogeneous construction and order
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Compare annotated/inferred [4096,256,16,1] using length and all four elements. Fill initialized five-element List to1..5 and check sum/helper length. Construct both scalar concat orders and ASCII repetition using ordinary writes/appends. Check ordered five Text values.
proposed_regressions.expected: length4,index 1=256 and all other values; sum15,length5; [1,2,3,4] versus[3,4,1,2]; abcd,abababab length8,aaaa length4; ordered hello,this,is,my,thing
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Inference/effect/append-order fixtures exist. New fixture preserves bounded values only; no Zig operators/width/pointer/comptime claim.

proposed_regressions.name: Nested literal independence and deliberate sharing
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Construct [[1,2],[3,4]], check all four cells, mutate one row and check the other. In a separate control construct [row,row] and show both entries see the same mutation. Retain a row while replacing one outer element and check the saved row.
proposed_regressions.expected: initial 1,2,3,4; distinct literal rows independent; deliberate shared rows both change; saved row survives replacement
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Dynamically built independent rows exist; literal-versus-shared controls and replacement lifetime are pending narrow additions.

proposed_regressions.name: Empty containers have no sentinel
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Check empty annotated Integer List and Bytes() lengths zero. Consider separate future negative cases for reading/writing index 0, retaining existing bounds diagnostics. Add no terminator as a sentinel substitute.
proposed_regressions.expected: lengths0; each index 0 access stops with existing bounds error
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Zero-length List bounds/contextual empties already exist. Inspect all Bytes diagnostic fixtures before adding a companion; no new coverage claim.

proposed_regressions.name: Shared scalar records in an owner-held List
proposed_regressions.original_regression: Construct three initialized Sub records, keep backing List alias, put that List in an owner record, mutate three element fields through the owner and check the backing alias. Keep a saved element, replace one List position, and check the saved record.
proposed_regressions.expected: backing fields 1,2,3; saved element remains accessible after replacement
proposed_regressions.existing_gap: Related nested List/record and Bytes aliases exist; this precise three-field observation plus lifetime control remains proposed.
